zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：岡山桃太郎機場演練降落事故救援、愛爾蘭航空改裝 10 架 A330，首設豪華經濟艙、Schiebel 在奧地利完成 S-100 概念驗證
zh.summary: 本期收錄3則獨立消息：岡山桃太郎機場演練降落事故救援、愛爾蘭航空改裝 10 架 A330，首設豪華經濟艙、Schiebel 在奧地利完成 S-100 概念驗證。
body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。

1. 岡山桃太郎機場演練降落事故救援
岡山桃太郎機場 11 月 24 日以客機降落時發生事故為情境舉辦演練，參與人員檢查傷患救援、檢傷分類及初期應變。

2. 愛爾蘭航空改裝 10 架 A330，首設豪華經濟艙
愛爾蘭航空宣布改裝 10 架空中巴士 A330，並首次引進豪華經濟艙。首架改裝客機預計自 2027 年 10 月 1 日起，執飛部分都柏林至紐約甘迺迪機場航班。

3. Schiebel 在奧地利完成 S-100 概念驗證
奧地利航空器製造商 Schiebel 公布，已與 Osiris Poland 在奧地利完成 Camcopter S-100 搭載小型無人機的概念驗證。公開資訊描述的是展示試驗。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Okayama Airport rehearses its response to a landing accident; Aer Lingus to retrofit ten A330s with its first premium economy cabin; Schiebel reports a Camcopter S-100 concept demonstration in Austria
en.summary: 3 independent updates: Okayama Airport rehearses its response to a landing accident; Aer Lingus to retrofit ten A330s with its first premium economy cabin; Schiebel reports a Camcopter S-100 concept demonstration in Austria.
body:
1. Okayama Airport rehearses its response to a landing accident
Okayama Momotaro Airport held a landing-accident exercise on Nov. 24 to rehearse casualty rescue, triage and the initial emergency response.

2. Aer Lingus to retrofit ten A330s with its first premium economy cabin
Aer Lingus plans to refurbish ten Airbus A330s and introduce its first premium economy cabin. The first refurbished aircraft is scheduled to serve selected Dublin–New York JFK flights from Oct. 1, 2027.

3. Schiebel reports a Camcopter S-100 concept demonstration in Austria
Schiebel said it and Osiris Poland completed an Austrian proof-of-concept demonstration involving a Camcopter S-100 carrying a separate small uncrewed aircraft. The companies described the event as a demonstration.
